ANY_VALUE.summary: Returns one non-null value from the input set.
ANY_VALUE.description: Returns one non-null value from the input set.
ANY_VALUE.documentation: Useful when a grouped query only needs one representative value from each group.

APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT.summary: Estimates the number of distinct input values.
APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT.description: Estimates the number of distinct input values.
APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT.documentation: Uses a sketch-based estimator instead of exact deduplication.

APPROX_PERCENTILE.summary: Estimates a percentile using sketch-based aggregation.
APPROX_PERCENTILE.description: Estimates a percentile using sketch-based aggregation.
APPROX_PERCENTILE.documentation: Accepts an input expression and a percentile literal between 0.0 and 1.0.

ARRAY_AGG.summary: Collects input values into an array.
ARRAY_AGG.description: Collects input values into an array.
ARRAY_AGG.documentation: Supports DISTINCT, ORDER BY, and LIMIT forms in the aggregate surface.
sql_forms: ARRAY_AGG(expr ORDER BY expr [ASC|DESC] LIMIT n)

AVG.summary: Computes the arithmetic mean of the input values.
AVG.description: Computes the arithmetic mean of the input values.
AVG.documentation: Ignores nulls and divides the running sum by the number of non-null values.

COUNT.summary: Counts rows or non-null input values.
COUNT.description: Counts rows or non-null input values.
COUNT.documentation: COUNT(*) counts rows, while COUNT(expr) counts non-null values.

COUNT_DISTINCT.documentation: Exact distinct count over the non-null input values.

MAX.summary: Returns the largest non-null input value.
MAX.description: Returns the largest non-null input value.
MAX.documentation: Returns the greatest comparable non-null value encountered.

MIN.summary: Returns the smallest non-null input value.
MIN.description: Returns the smallest non-null input value.
MIN.documentation: Returns the smallest comparable non-null value encountered.

SUM.documentation: Nulls are ignored; non-null values are accumulated.
